description: ML-DSA-65 (RFC 9964 AKP, alg -49) known-answer vectors. Produced and checked by gen-ml-dsa-65.sh with OpenSSL alone.

rfc9964_figure7.note: RFC 9964 Appendix A, Figure 7 (ML_DSA_65): the all-zero seed, its raw public key, and the COSE_Key kid (the RFC 9679 thumbprint over {kty, alg, pub}). Copied from the RFC text; not the project key.

valid.name: deterministic
valid.why: Pure ML-DSA-65, empty context, deterministic signing (all-zero randomness). Another implementation signing hedged will not reproduce these bytes; treat them as verify-only.

invalid.name: context-pmr
invalid.why: Signed with context string "pmr". The profile requires the empty context, so this must be refused; it verifies only with context-string:pmr.

invalid.name: bit-flipped
invalid.why: The valid signature with the low bit of its first byte flipped.

invalid.name: alg-relabelled
invalid.why: The valid signature carried on a request whose alg is relabelled ed25519. The signature verifies over the original base only, not over this relabelled one; the verifier refuses it on profile grounds, before any signature check, because alg ed25519 does not match an AKP/ML-DSA-65 key.
